record.question: Under Section 2(o) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, a "non-cognizable offence" means:
options: An offence for which a police officer may also arrest without warrant.
An offence punishable with imprisonment for life.
An offence in which a police officer has no authority to arrest without a warrant.
An offence that can be tried only by a Court of Session.
